ONNX Runtime Web, MIT. https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
Model: Xenova/paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2

Base model: sentence-transformers/paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2, Apache-2.0.
https://huggingface.co/sentence-transformers/paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2
https://huggingface.co/Xenova/paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2
Model weights are fetched directly from the model publisher only after the user requests analysis.
The essay is processed locally and is not sent to Hugging Face or an inference API.
Editorial topic vectors are generated from the Olena proposal catalogue with the pinned model.
This is experimental thematic triage, not an official ENEM evaluation or automatic zero.
